atoms.name: Allocation methods
atoms.one_line: Contiguous: fast, fragments. Linked: no fragments, slow random access. Indexed: direct access, no fragments.

atoms.name: Linked allocation and FAT
atoms.one_line: Usable bytes per block = block - pointer; a FAT moves all links into one table on disk.

atoms.name: Inodes and maximum file size
atoms.one_line: P = block / address; size = (direct + P + P^2 + P^3) x block.

atoms.name: Free-space management
atoms.one_line: Bitmap: one bit per block. Linked list: one pointer slot per list block.

atoms.name: Disk geometry and capacity
atoms.one_line: Capacity = surfaces x cylinders x sectors x sector size; sector number from <c, h, s>.

atoms.name: Disk access time
atoms.one_line: Seek + half rotation + sector/track fraction of a rotation; scattered sectors pay it each time.

atoms.name: FCFS and SSTF scheduling
atoms.one_line: FCFS follows arrival order. SSTF takes the nearest request and can starve far ones.

atoms.name: SCAN, LOOK and C-LOOK
atoms.one_line: SCAN and LOOK sweep both ways; C-LOOK sweeps one way and the jump back counts.
